findings.issue: The rendered final scientific completion gate is FAIL, but manifest creation enforces only mechanical gates and can label the release verified.
findings.required_fix: Require all mandatory scientific gates to pass before production manifest creation and deployment; otherwise mark the manifest provisional and block promotion.

findings.issue: The public HTML publishes record_id, patient_id, acquisition identifiers, and rhythm labels; the current Plotly payload contains 360 distinct MUSE identifiers.
findings.required_fix: Publish only release-specific random identifiers, keep mappings private, omit acquisition filenames and patient IDs, and add a release-time privacy scan.

findings.issue: Live SQLite reads are not a coherent immutable snapshot, WAL-backed updates are misreported by base-file metadata, and most live databases are absent from the manifest.
findings.required_fix: Create immutable SQLite backup snapshots at build start, render all live chapters from them, and hash every snapshot under one snapshot/generation ID.

findings.issue: Chapters and the manifest are written directly into the live _book directory, so interruption can leave a mixed-generation deployment.
findings.required_fix: Render and audit a versioned staging directory and atomically promote it only after all gates pass.

findings.issue: The deployable pages depend on remote JQuery, RequireJS, Plotly, MathJax, and Polyfill despite the resource-closure claim, and the audit does not gate external runtimes.
findings.required_fix: Vendor pinned runtime assets, distinguish runtime dependencies from hyperlinks, fail on unapproved remote scripts/styles, and hash all deployed resources.

findings.issue: Render state, audit state, and manifest creation are not bound to source, helper, configuration, environment, or data hashes; the auditor also omits stale_html from its exit condition.
findings.required_fix: Bind artifacts to a run ID and complete input hashes, rerun the audit during manifest creation, gate stale HTML, and fully rerender the current wrong-renderer/stale pages.

findings.issue: The timeout handler concatenates byte output with strings and raises TypeError, while descendant Jupyter processes may survive.
findings.required_fix: Decode timeout output, manage renders as process groups, kill descendants on timeout, and persist failure state in finally.

findings.issue: Rendering depends on a hard-coded user virtualenv and registered kernel without a dependency lock or recorded Python/platform package identity.
findings.required_fix: Provide a checked-in locked environment and deterministic kernel setup, use repository-relative configuration, and record interpreter, platform, and lock hashes.

findings.issue: Canonical membership and cross-protocol joins rely on model-name strings/model_id instead of verified generation and artifact digests; current clinical rows mix legacy_v1 and missing_leads_v2.
findings.required_fix: Join displayed results to a locked manifest and require checkpoint, evaluator, protocol, preprocessing, dataset, and generation hashes to match.

findings.issue: The paired-inference view ranks 1,576 comparisons by raw p-values without multiplicity control.
findings.required_fix: Prespecify confirmatory families and endpoints, report adjusted p-values or simultaneous intervals, and label unadjusted screens exploratory.

findings.issue: Reported bootstrap confidence intervals assume record independence although distinct source-person identity is unverified.
findings.required_fix: Recover person/site mappings and split/bootstrap by those clusters, or remove inferential confidence language and report record-level descriptive estimates.

findings.issue: Confusion-matrix and projection plots choose model_id.iloc[-1] from unordered query results, making the showcased checkpoint arbitrary and nondeterministic.
findings.required_fix: Use an explicit locked model/checkpoint selector, filter by exact job and digest, and assert uniqueness and completeness.

findings.issue: The chapter advertises registered mechanism contrasts but computes only comparisons to A0_raw and presents single-run aggregates as means while replication is absent.
findings.required_fix: Implement exact matched incremental and R0-versus-R1 contrasts across all registered matching factors and keep results screening-only until replicated.
